mentions.description: This tool provides end-to-end accessibility (a11y) compliance, taking care of auditing, remediation, verification, and generation of ACR/VPAT reports. It leverages LLMs, with the well-bound nature of the accessibility compliance problem space enabling an end-to-end product.
